themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems for research purposes.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrated into IDEs or command-line interfaces.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and applications designed to facilitate and enhance various research processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, research papers, or meeting transcripts into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Covers AI applications used for analyzing datasets, identifying patterns, and deriving insights from research or user data.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI tools are used to assist in the design process, from concept generation and prototyping to UI/UX improvements.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is affecting jobs, skills requirements, and the overall nature of work across different industries.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency, and identifying defects.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools for research purposes, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications designed to enhance survey creation, distribution, analysis, and response interpretation.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
